description: This file defines a static class with an extension method for IClientBuilder that configures the builder to use transactions by integrating with a transaction-related service.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IClientBuilder to simplify configuration of transaction support.

methods.name: UseTransactions
methods.description: An extension method that configures the IClientBuilder to support transactions by calling UseTransactionsWithClient on the service collection.
